ar1_phi_cpu.method: lag-1 autocorr of CPU residual after removing weekday/weekend hour-of-day profile and day offset

ar1_phi_cpu_azure.method: same method on Azure avg CPU (cross-check)

ar1_sigma_model.method: log-log regression of residual std on mean CPU: sigma = a * mean^b

memory_bound.note: Alibaba mem% is relative to the container limit (median ~96%), not VM RAM; no public VM trace here has memory % -> memory_bound level stays an assumption

daily_amp_ratio.method: (max - min) of weekday hourly profile / mean

disk_elasticity.method: OLS slope of log(read+write) on log(cpu%+0.5)

drift_sd.method: std of day mean / mean of same day-type (weekday or weekend)

iops_base_alibaba.method: per-machine OLS intercept of disk_io% on cpu%

iops_k_alibaba.method: per-machine OLS slope of disk_io% on cpu%

iops_lognorm_sigma.method: std of log(actual / OLS fit), disk throughput

mem_ar1_phi.method: lag-1 autocorr of memory residual (same method as CPU)

mem_base_alibaba.method: per-machine OLS intercept of mem% on cpu%

mem_coupling.method: per-machine OLS slope of mem% on cpu%

mem_cv_active.method: std/mean of memory usage per VM

mem_noise_sd_pct.method: std of mem% residual after OLS on cpu% (percentage points)

mem_resid_rel_sd.method: std of memory residual / mean memory

missing_share_alibaba.method: NaN share per machine in the mirror

missing_share_bitbrains.method: NaN share per VM in the mirror

net_base_over_k.method: OLS (rx+tx) = c0 + c1*cpu%; c0/c1 in CPU-% units

net_elasticity.method: OLS slope of log(rx+tx) on log(cpu%+0.5)

net_lognorm_sigma.method: std of log(actual / OLS fit), network

peak_hour_local.method: hour of weekday profile maximum, local time (UTC+2), interactive VMs

share_vms_mean_below_0p5.method: share of the 1,250 VMs dropped as ~0% CPU (zombie-like)

weekend_factor_all.method: weekend mean / weekday mean, all VMs

weekend_factor_interactive.method: weekend mean / weekday mean, VMs with daily amplitude ratio > 0.5
